corrections.reason: The printed glyph is 1st-order አ (አገር አቅንተው, 'developing/settling a town/land'), misread as 6th-order እ.
Both visually and philologically, the canonical Ge'ez/Andemta term in the cinco-mode healing formula is በግሣጼ ('by rebuke/command', alongside በሐልዮ and በነቢብ), where ግ was misread as ገ and ጼ as ሥ.
